# SoneVibe

SoneVibe is a Uniswap V2-style constant-product DEX on Soneium (chain ID 1868). Each swap pays a flat 0.25% fee (9975/10000), taken from the input and left in the pool. Liquidity providers earn 5/6 of that fee. The protocol treasury receives 1/6. Yields and APR are variable, not guaranteed. The factory init code hash is 0xa62c15518ad5af48799fb77c27e4842a2e89b712da003c13a836899d76a89a38. A flash swap calls vibeCall, not uniswapV2Call.

The same DEX is also on Arbitrum One (chain ID 42161). Use the Arbitrum section below for those addresses. The Soneium init code hash above is not the Arbitrum hash.

Public RPC: https://rpc.soneium.org
Block explorer: https://soneium.blockscout.com/

Contracts on Soneium mainnet, copied from docs/networks.json:
- Router: 0xa393E76bE079cF1ccf684D0f815795Dde248f157
- Factory: 0x06C0b58287794a0bdce20ce768b601CA974618DC
- Farm chef (VibeMasterChefV2): 0x8f2F9B17b173C91c7B9195096030a39227B94f62

Farm pools, LP tokens, and token addresses are in the machine-readable index:
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/agents.json

Arbitrum One (chain ID 42161):
Public RPC: https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc
Fallback RPC: https://arbitrum-one.publicnode.com
Block explorer: https://arbiscan.io
- Router: 0x8BE6469287A872B34665F5c0c8fbce73c0Dcbf72
- Factory: 0xA95107ebE4e54480bA755061eF3207c3421150f0
- WETH: 0x82aF49447D8a07e3bd95BD0d56f35241523fBab1
- USDC: 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831
- WETH/USDC pair: 0x4DF5bcAC28b8898988Ba576B8463664b53ddb9F7
  factory.getPair(WETH, USDC) returns this pair. token0 is WETH. token1 is USDC.
Swap fee: 0.25% (9975/10000).
Factory init code hash: 0x87b780b5d19df9ad0d4c866dcd6b169f14846fb24232a128b678c5bdb395b012
Sourcify exact match. The factory fund-rescue function is removed: Soneium's factory has rescueFundsFromPair, and the Arbitrum factory does not. The router still has owner-only rescueFunds(address), which can move only ETH or ERC-20 already held by the router and cannot access pair liquidity.

Minimal ABIs (Router, Pair, Factory, ERC20):
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/abi/router.json
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/abi/pair.json
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/abi/factory.json
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/abi/erc20.json

A read-only quote and a swap transaction with amountOutMin and a deadline:
https://sonevibe.github.io/Lending/examples/swap-viem.md
The user's own wallet signs. Private keys never belong in code.

A pools.json data feed is coming. The backend owns that file. It is not published here yet.
